title: I'm Yours

cues.en: Well, you done, done me in, you bet I felt it
cues.zh: 你徹底俘虜了我的心，你肯定感覺到了
cues.text: Well, you done, done me in, you bet I felt it

cues.en: I tried to be chill, but you're so hot that I melted
cues.zh: 我試圖冷靜下來，但你太熱了，我融化了
cues.text: I tried to be chill, but you're so hot that I melted

cues.en: I fell right through the cracks
cues.zh: 我從裂縫中摔了下來
cues.text: I fell right through the cracks

cues.en: Now I'm trying to get back
cues.zh: 現在我正嘗試回去
cues.text: Now I'm trying to get back

cues.en: Before the cool done run out, I'll be givin' it my bestest
cues.zh: 在冷卻完畢之前，我會給它最好的
cues.text: Before the cool done run out, I'll be givin' it my bestest

cues.en: And nothing's gonna stop me but divine intervention
cues.zh: 除了神聖的幹預，沒有甚麼能阻止我
cues.text: And nothing's gonna stop me but divine intervention

cues.en: I reckon it's again my turn
cues.zh: 我想又輪到我了
cues.text: I reckon it's again my turn

cues.en: To win some or learn some
cues.zh: 贏得一些或學習一些
cues.text: To win some or learn some

cues.en: But I won't hesitate no more, no more
cues.zh: 但我不會再猶豫了
cues.text: But I won't hesitate no more, no more

cues.en: It cannot wait, I'm yours
cues.zh: 我等不及了，我是你的
cues.text: It cannot wait, I'm yours

cues.en: Well, open up your mind and see like me
cues.zh: 好吧，敞開心扉，像我一樣看待
cues.text: Well, open up your mind and see like me

cues.en: Open up your plans and, damn, you're free
cues.zh: 開啟你的計劃，該死的，你自由了
cues.text: Open up your plans and, damn, you're free

cues.en: Look into your heart, and you'll find love, love, love, love
cues.zh: 凝視你的心靈，你會發現滿滿的愛
cues.text: Look into your heart, and you'll find love, love, love, love

cues.en: Listen to the music of the moment people dance and sing
cues.zh: 聆聽人們跳舞和唱歌的音樂
cues.text: Listen to the music of the moment people dance and sing

cues.en: We're just one big family
cues.zh: 我們只是一個大家庭
cues.text: We're just one big family

cues.en: And it's our godforsaken right to be loved, loved, loved, loved, loved
cues.zh: 被深愛著是我們生來應得的權利
cues.text: And it's our godforsaken right to be loved, loved, loved, loved, loved

cues.en: So I won't hesitate no more, no more
cues.zh: 所以我不會再猶豫了
cues.text: So I won't hesitate no more, no more

cues.en: It cannot wait, I'm sure
cues.zh: 等不及了，我敢肯定
cues.text: It cannot wait, I'm sure

cues.en: There's no need to complicate, our time is short
cues.zh: 沒有必要複雜化，我們的時間很短
cues.text: There's no need to complicate, our time is short

cues.en: This is our fate, I'm yours
cues.zh: 這是我們的命運，我是你的
cues.text: This is our fate, I'm yours

cues.en: Do, do, do, do you
cues.zh: 做，做，做，做
cues.text: Do, do, do, do you

cues.en: But do you, do you, do, do
cues.zh: 但是你，你，你，做，做
cues.text: But do you, do you, do, do

cues.en: But do you want to come on?
cues.zh: 但你想來嗎？
cues.text: But do you want to come on?

cues.en: Scooch on over closer, dear
cues.zh: 親愛的，繼續往前走
cues.text: Scooch on over closer, dear

cues.en: And I will nibble your ear
cues.zh: 我會咬你的耳朵
cues.text: And I will nibble your ear

cues.en: I've been spending way too long checking my tongue in the mirror
cues.zh: 我花了太長時間在鏡子裡檢查我的舌頭
cues.text: I've been spending way too long checking my tongue in the mirror

cues.en: And bending over backwards just to try to see it clearer
cues.zh: 費盡心思只為了看得更清楚
cues.text: And bending over backwards just to try to see it clearer

cues.en: But my breath fogged up the glass
cues.zh: 但我的呼吸讓鏡面模糊了
cues.text: But my breath fogged up the glass

cues.en: And so I drew a new face and I laughed
cues.zh: 所以我畫了一張新臉，然後笑了出來
cues.text: And so I drew a new face and I laughed

cues.en: I guess what I'll be saying is there ain't no better reason
cues.zh: 我想我要說的是，沒有更好的理由
cues.text: I guess what I'll be saying is there ain't no better reason

cues.en: To rid yourself of vanities and just go with the seasons
cues.zh: 拋開虛榮心，順應自然的節奏
cues.text: To rid yourself of vanities and just go with the seasons

cues.en: It's what we aim to do
cues.zh: 這正是我們的目標
cues.text: It's what we aim to do

cues.en: Our name is our virtue
cues.zh: 我們的名字就是我們的美德
cues.text: Our name is our virtue

cues.en: But I won't hesitate no more, no more
cues.zh: 但我不會再猶豫了
cues.text: But I won't hesitate no more, no more

cues.en: It cannot wait, I'm yours
cues.zh: 我等不及了，我是你的
cues.text: It cannot wait, I'm yours

cues.en: Open up your mind and see like me
cues.zh: 敞開心扉，像我一樣看待
cues.text: Open up your mind and see like me

cues.en: Open up your plans and, damn, you're free
cues.zh: 開啟你的計劃，該死的，你自由了
cues.text: Open up your plans and, damn, you're free

cues.en: Look into your heart, and you'll find that the sky is yours
cues.zh: 深入你的內心，你會發現天空是你的
cues.text: Look into your heart, and you'll find that the sky is yours

cues.en: So please don't, please don't, please don't
cues.zh: 所以請不要，請不要，請不要
cues.text: So please don't, please don't, please don't

cues.en: There's no need to complicate
cues.zh: 無需複雜化
cues.text: There's no need to complicate

cues.en: 'Cause our time is short
cues.zh: 因為我們的時間很短
cues.text: 'Cause our time is short

cues.en: This, oh, this, oh, this is our fate
cues.zh: 這，噢，這，噢，這是我們的命運
cues.text: This, oh, this, oh, this is our fate

cues.en: I'm yours
cues.zh: 我是你的
cues.text: I'm yours

cues.en: Oh, I'm yours
cues.zh: 哦，我是你的
cues.text: Oh, I'm yours

cues.en: Oh, I'm yours
cues.zh: 哦，我是你的
cues.text: Oh, I'm yours

cues.en: Oh, whoa-oh
cues.zh: 噢，哇噢
cues.text: Oh, whoa-oh

cues.en: Baby, do believe I'm yours
cues.zh: 寶貝，相信我是你的
cues.text: Baby, do believe I'm yours

cues.en: You best believe, you best believe I'm yours
cues.zh: 你最好相信，你最好相信我是你的
cues.text: You best believe, you best believe I'm yours
